Apesh
Apesh
was an Ancient Egyptian god of the night who had the head of a
turtle
or
tortoise
. He was considered to be an evil god because turtles were considered to be an evil animal and Apesh represented them.
[
2
]
In the
Book of the Dead
the turtle and by extension Apesh is depicted as an "enemy of
Ra
"; in chapter 161 of the
Book of the Dead
,
Thoth
is quoted repeating "May
Ra
live and turtle die".
